definition.description: The presence or absence of gene amplification in a patient sample.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the pretreatment record indicates the status of gene amplification (e.g., via FISH or NGS) as amplified or non-amplified/negative.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if gene amplification status is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: gene_amplification_status

definition.description: Presence or absence of a genetic mutation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether a genetic mutation is reported as present (e.g., 'mutation', 'loss of [gene]', 'deletion mutation') or explicitly reported as absent/wild-type from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no information regarding genetic mutation status is documented.
definition.name: genetic_mutation_status

definition.description: The total amount of genomic DNA used as input for the molecular assay.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric quantity of genomic DNA input, reported in nanograms (ng), from the molecular pathology or laboratory report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the DNA input amount is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: genomic_dna_input_amount

definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient has a diagnosis of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) as listed in comorbidities, past medical history, or indicated by the use of GERD-specific medications such as omeprazole.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of GERD or associated medications in the patient record.
definition.name: gerd_presence

definition.description: Qualitative appearance of the ocular globes on imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: From the orbits section of the radiology report, identify if the globes are described as within normal limits or unremarkable (Normal), or if any pathology, mass, or abnormal enhancement is noted (Abnormal).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the globes are not mentioned or the documentation is insufficient to determine status.
definition.name: globe_appearance

definition.description: The concentration of glucose in the blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the blood glucose level recorded in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no glucose measurement is documented.
definition.name: glucose_level

definition.description: Patient use of growth factor support to mitigate or treat chemotherapy-induced neutropenia.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the patient was prescribed or administered growth factor support (e.g., G-CSF, filgrastim, pegfilgrastim) as documented in the medications list, treatment plan, or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of growth factor support is found in the record, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: growth_factor_support_use

definition.description: The patient's head shape and trauma status as documented during a physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the description of the head's shape and the presence or absence of trauma. A finding of 'normocephalic atraumatic' (or 'NC/AT') indicates a normal head shape and the absence of trauma.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the head shape and trauma status are not documented or are ambiguous.
definition.name: head_shape_and_trauma_status

definition.description: Whether the patient reports or is documented to have a headache.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence of a headache from the pretreatment clinical record. Documentation is typically found in the History of Present Illness (HPI), the Review of Systems (specifically the HEENT or Neurologic sections), or the Assessment/Plan (e.g., 'intermittent headaches', 'no headache', 'denies headache').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the presence of headache is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: headache_presence

definition.description: Patient's heart rate measured in beats per minute.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the heart rate (HR) from the vital signs section of the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If heart rate is not documented or is recorded as ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: heart_rate

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
